name: Quadric Error Function (QEF) for Sharp Features
aliases: QEF, QEF Solver, QEF for Sharp Features, Quadric Error Function Solver
definition: A method to find the optimal point representing a sharp corner or edge by minimizing the distance to multiple planes defined by intersection points and their normals. Solved using Singular Value Decomposition (SVD).
summary: QEF for Sharp Features computes optimal vertex positions for corners and edges in dual contouring by minimizing distances to intersecting planes via least-squares, handling underdetermined systems that standard solvers cannot.
